Now I can see the vulnerability. In `process_blend`:

```cpp
unsigned int start = env.argStack.get_count () - ((k+1) * n);
```

If `(k+1) * n` is larger than `env.argStack.get_count()`, then `start` underflows (wraps around), leading to an out-of-bounds read when accessing `env.argStack[start + i]`.
